name: Nordic SoftDevice Controller (binary library inside nrf-sdc-sys)
relevance: availability only: the BLE task cannot move the motor or feed the watchdog (firmware-rs/docs/architecture.md)

name: Nordic MPSL (binary library inside nrf-mpsl-sys)
purpose: radio scheduling and flash timeslot API
relevance: affects tick jitter during flash writes; not measured on hardware

name: nRF52840 silicon and errata (Nordic)
relevance: flash erase stalls the CPU (about 85 ms per page); TRNG seeds the DRBG

name: Rust toolchain (rustc stable; thumbv7em-none-eabihf)
version: exact rustc version to be pinned (no rust-toolchain file in the repo)
purpose: compiler and core library for all firmware
relevance: compiler is SOUP: pin the version and record it in the release record

name: Apple iOS CoreBluetooth / CryptoKit / Keychain
version: minimum iOS version to be confirmed in ios/OpenPatchKit/Support/Config.xcconfig
purpose: BLE central role; X25519/HKDF/HMAC/SHA-256; secret storage
relevance: phone-side security and transport; OS updates are outside the manufacturer's control

name: LoopKit (PumpManager protocol and UI types)
purpose: host framework interfaces used by OpenPatchKit
relevance: interface contract to the algorithm app; upstream changes can break compatibility

name: Trio (nightscout/Trio) host app
version: not pinned (the user installs a build)
purpose: algorithm and UI that calls OpenPatchKit
relevance: for a regulated product the manufacturer must control the host app version or specify the interface (FDA ACE pump special controls require a validated interface specification)

name: Xcode / Swift toolchain
relevance: tool; output verified by the Swift test suite

name: KiCad 10 (PCB design and DRC)
purpose: PCB generation and design rule checks
